promoted.name: Annual budget preparation
promoted.definition: Collecting salary, staffing and training inputs from managers to draft the next year's budget.

promoted.name: External audit support requests
promoted.definition: Supplying deal tickets, confirmations, valuations and P&L support that external auditors request for their periodic testing, and tracking open requests.

promoted.name: Nightly book officialization
promoted.definition: Keeping the list of trading books officialized each night, marking them official and following up on books that are missed.

promoted.name: Contract status reporting
promoted.definition: Circulating the periodic report of contract assignments, terminations, expirations and contracts in process.

promoted.name: Contract termination handling
promoted.definition: Checking whether a contract can be terminated, deciding on notice and preparing and sending termination letters.

promoted.name: Cost center allocation and charge review
promoted.definition: Setting monthly and plan cost allocation percentages, distributing cost center and labor reports, and getting misposted charges corrected.

promoted.name: Counterparty credit controls
promoted.definition: Telling desks when a counterparty is restricted or approved to trade, and taking or allocating credit reserves on named transactions.

promoted.name: Counterparty reference data changes
promoted.definition: Announcing counterparty name changes, mergers, inactivations and reference data changes, and circulating the updated counterparty list.

promoted.name: Customer event planning
promoted.definition: Organising the annual customer meeting and trip: proposals, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, rooming and itineraries.

promoted.name: Customer price quotes and bids
promoted.definition: Receiving customer requests for gas bids, hedges or fixed forward prices, pricing them and following up with quotes.

promoted.name: Deal booking checks and corrections
promoted.definition: Checking booked trades for the right counterparty, terms, classification and cross-system links, and rebooking or correcting deals that are wrong.

promoted.name: Deal confirmation
promoted.definition: Issuing, chasing and passing on written confirmations of gas purchases and sales with counterparties.

promoted.name: Deal entry rules and procedures
promoted.definition: Setting and reminding desks of the rules for entering, changing and documenting deals in the trading systems, including templates and change controls.

promoted.name: Deal pathing and buyback links
promoted.definition: Pathing deal volumes to contracts in the scheduling systems, linking buybacks with market deals and validating path data.

promoted.name: Desk responsibility assignment
promoted.definition: Assigning and announcing who handles which pipelines, counterparties, regions or duties, and handing work over when staff change.

promoted.name: Distribution and contact list upkeep
promoted.definition: Adding, removing and correcting names and addresses on report distribution and group contact lists.

promoted.name: Divestiture transition
promoted.definition: Tracking transition issues, procedures, deal data, rosters and system separation when a business is sold or handed to a new owner.

promoted.name: EnronOnline product set-up
promoted.definition: Defining, reviewing and launching new EnronOnline products, their wording, index and book mapping, and how they are ticketed in the deal systems.

promoted.name: HR record and pay administration
promoted.definition: Requesting changes to employee records, pay, deductions and benefits, and collecting HR surveys and roster checks from staff.

promoted.name: Market report and news circulation
promoted.definition: Circulating daily market reports, news, market analysis and call notes to traders and originators.

promoted.name: Internal meeting scheduling
promoted.definition: Scheduling group, staff and management meetings and events, collecting availability and attendance, and arranging rooms.

promoted.name: Meter and point set-up
promoted.definition: Setting up, changing and retiring meters, pooling, receipt, delivery and storage points and their mappings in the facility and scheduling systems.

promoted.name: Office and IT equipment requests
promoted.definition: Ordering, installing and managing computers, phones, turrets and cell phone plans for staff, and confirming receipt so purchases can be paid.

promoted.name: Office move coordination
promoted.definition: Scheduling staff and workstation moves with facilities and passing on packing and labeling instructions.

promoted.name: Origination credit tracking
promoted.definition: Recording, requesting and reconciling origination amounts granted on deals so each desk's origination schedule and report are complete.

promoted.name: Pipeline project evaluation
promoted.definition: Gathering cost estimates, maps, economics and requests for proposed pipeline expansion and interconnect projects.

promoted.name: Plant outage notices
promoted.definition: Notifying gas schedulers and commercial staff when a methanol or MTBE plant goes down, runs reduced or restarts.

promoted.name: Price data requests
promoted.definition: Looking up and sending index, basis and Gas Daily prices or historical market data to colleagues and customers who ask for them.

promoted.name: Prior month adjustment review
promoted.definition: Distributing, reviewing and clearing monthly prior month adjustments, including price and volume true-ups and unexplained differences.

promoted.name: Real-time model and data file distribution
promoted.definition: Sending the daily real-time models, deal sheets and hourly data files to EES, EPE and settlements, and reconciling them against reports.

promoted.name: Staff recruiting and hiring
promoted.definition: Collecting hiring needs, posting openings, handling candidates and scheduling interviews to fill analyst, trader and support positions.

promoted.name: Staff training arrangement
promoted.definition: Planning, scheduling and approving training classes, system sessions, cross-training and desk sit-ins for staff.

promoted.name: Staff transfer onboarding
promoted.definition: Organising orientation sessions, pre-employment checks, benefits and paperwork for staff moving to a new employer.

promoted.name: Travel arrangement
promoted.definition: Booking, confirming and approving flights, hotels and itineraries for trips and visits.

promoted.name: Vacation and time-off scheduling
promoted.definition: Collecting staff vacation dates, approving time off and announcing who covers each absent person's duties.
